# Markdown renderer

`markdown-it.mjs` is the unmodified browser ESM bundle from markdown-it 15.0.2
(`dist/browser/markdown-it.esm.min.mjs`), distributed under the adjacent MIT license.
Bundled dependency notices are in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`.
Source: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.2.tgz
Package SHA-512 (base64): q4IGxMv56jCqT4OCRCADBoDP3LO4MhmTXjFbphHPXs4g3j9Xg5RDnxqN8IF/3vIWEU+VCnUq+7JUg/cfy2E6Qw==

The bundle is served locally; no CDN or frontend build is needed. To update,
replace the bundle and license from a pinned npm release and run the chat
Markdown security and workspace browser tests. Source maps are not distributed.
